title: Safe Saving
goal: Compare where money can be kept and understand protection and growth.

cards.text: Money kept at home can be lost, stolen or spent. A bank account keeps it protected.

voice.speak_text: Money kept at home can be lost, stolen or spent. A bank account keeps it protected. Say next to continue.

cards.text: {indicator}: {group_percent}% of people like you, compared with {benchmark_percent}% overall.

voice.speak_text: {indicator}: {group_percent} percent of people like you, compared with {benchmark_percent} percent overall. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Saving a little from every allowance or paycheck adds up faster than you think.

voice.speak_text: Saving a little from every allowance or paycheck adds up faster than you think. Say next to continue.

cards.text: A separate savings account for the family keeps school and health money apart from daily spending.

voice.speak_text: A separate savings account for the family keeps school and health money apart from daily spending. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Many people also save with a {savings_group}. It builds the habit, but the money is not protected like a bank deposit.

voice.speak_text: Many people also save with a {savings_group}. It builds the habit, but the money is not protected like a bank deposit. Say next to continue.

cards.text: In retirement, keep savings somewhere protected that you can still reach quickly when you need it.

voice.speak_text: In retirement, keep savings somewhere protected that you can still reach quickly when you need it. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Save a small, fixed amount every time money comes in, before you spend on anything else.

voice.speak_text: Save a small, fixed amount every time money comes in, before you spend on anything else. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Saving first for emergencies means a surprise bill does not become a loan.

voice.speak_text: Saving first for emergencies means a surprise bill does not become a loan. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Where is your money protected if something goes wrong?

options.a: In a licensed bank with deposit insurance

voice.speak_text: Where is your money protected if something goes wrong? A: in a licensed bank with deposit insurance. B: under the mattress. C: with a friend. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.a: in a licensed bank with deposit insurance

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Deposits at a licensed bank are protected by {deposit_insurer}, even if the bank fails.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. Deposits at a licensed bank are protected by {deposit_insurer}, even if the bank fails.

cards.text: You save {cur}100 and earn 10% interest a year. How much do you have after one year?

voice.speak_text: You save {cur}100 and earn 10 percent interest a year. How much do you have after one year? A: {cur}100. B: {cur}110. C: {cur}120. Say A, B or C.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. 10 percent of {cur}100 is {cur}10, so you have {cur}110.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is B. 10 percent of {cur}100 is {cur}10, so you have {cur}110.

cards.text: Keep savings somewhere protected, and let interest help them grow.

voice.speak_text: Remember: keep savings somewhere protected, and let interest help them grow. Say next to finish the lesson.
